scope: Shared indistinguishable-locus alleles and bounded conditional fragment-length inference. Comparison baseline includes the earlier fragment graph reduction and diagnostic improvements from this session.
method: Serial fresh processes, identical input bytes; source order alternates when comparing versions. Wall time excludes imports. RSS is max(parent, largest child), not concurrent total. Synthetic expected alleles are specified independently of caller agreement. Preparation is excluded from timing. All outputs and disagreements are retained.
standard_benchmark_command: python scripts/benchmark_fastq_inference.py --baseline-source BASELINE --workdir EMPTY_DIRECTORY --repetitions 3 --copies 2 --layouts paired shotgun --challenge

shared_locus_groups.reason: Shared sequence evidence cannot assign an allele or presence to individual member loci. Group fractions combine loci and do not establish strain fractions. Model support is uncalibrated.

calibrated_benchmark.method: Three alternating fresh-process trials on identical files; both versions receive mean260bp and SD30bp. Includes only the modeled two-class selection union, with a fixed 30bp left anchor and error-free 100bp mates. This validates conditional length inference, not whole-genome or real-sample accuracy.

limitations: Synthetic, organism-independent inputs; no server samples or matched real assembly/FASTQ cohort were available.
Group alleles do not assign individual loci, change per-locus fingerprints, or add measured classification votes.
The original difficult fixture remains 9/14 correct per-locus counts; shared group allele5 with40 molecules is reported separately.
The new calibrated fixture is an error-free conditional two-class library selection with fixed primary anchor and known Gaussian insert distribution. It is not a realistic whole-genome benchmark.
The conditional length model applies to isolate mode and valid independent insert calibration. Exact concrete motif tails and usable anchors are required.
No abundance inference from unassigned repeat-only reads. Pure mates alone, anchored lower bounds alone, and plausible long-length tails retain an unknown upper length.
Likelihood support and background assumptions are uncalibrated. Small timing trials are local overhead checks, not cohort scaling evidence.
